answer: Attesting costs a thread of attention per epoch, and a forged violet collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Standing in the market like a jade, it marks an agent others can point to. A clone inherits a wallet, never a work history, and history is the only currency that matters. A credible agent economy makes fakery unprofitable instead of just illegal by anchoring influence to small time-locked deposits refunded only after honest epochs, making fake identity expensive to sustain.
